rule.service_counter_availability: completed packet bytes and duration enter the window containing completion, never the window containing start
rule.per_port_report_cap: ceil(predeclared report_budget_horizon_ns / 1000 / period_us); independent of actual termination
rule.sampling_object: completed 1us local counter windows; never pretend these are instantaneous queue samples
rule.realistic_reference: port counters, common endpoint operations/topology, fixed-phase 1024ns queue histogram where that interface exists; not claimed to be available on A3
rule.unknown_policy: queue-only does not identify cause; no credit failure is not a continuous eligibility assertion; no actual same-head evidence means credit duration unknown
rule.review_policy: freeze before inspecting new smaller-scale labels; historical scales are related records, not independent generalization

correction: Known 1ms budget replaces future actual-end-derived cap; no threshold/traffic/backend changes
preservation: Old judged-v3/evaluated-v3 are retained. Final comparisons use judged-final/evaluated-final; preparation and backend execution unchanged.
